LACAN Documentation

LACAN (Leveraging Adjacent Co-occurrence of Atomic Neighborhoods) is a statistical filter and generative cheminformatics toolkit for scoring, mutating, and generating drug-like molecules using a model of bond environments learned from ChEMBL.
